maddeler.e:
انسجمت (form VII)
# اِنْسَجَمْتُ (insajamtu) /in.sa.d͡ʒam.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# اِنْسَجَمْتَ (insajamta) /in.sa.d͡ʒam.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# اِنْسَجَمْتِ (insajamti) /in.sa.d͡ʒam.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْسَجَمَ (insajama)
# اِنْسَجَمَتْ (insajamat) /in.sa.d͡ʒa.mat/: thir
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
